name: geosilo
description: Compact geometry encoding for DuckDB. Delta-encodes coordinates as scaled integers for 3–4× smaller geometry on disk and over the wire vs WKB. First-class GEOSILO column type with transparent ST_* interop, plus native overloads of common spatial functions that skip the WKB decode entirely.

cta.title: Compact Geometry Encoding
cta.description: Install GeoSilo for 3–4× smaller geometry storage and faster ST_* operations — drop-in compatible with the spatial extension.
